how do you play it..... 1) play more than one of a kind for each damage
resolution phase(i.e if there is a
BLUR there could be up to 3 damage
resolution phases
2) play more than one of a kind for the
entire round
3) only allowed one of each kind for
each damage resolution phase, or

each round.

play more than one of each kind, but playable only during *strike*
resolution.
